name: browser
description: Loopback-only Playwright browser daemon exposing a small HTTP API for navigation, interaction, screenshots, and JS evaluation with restorable local state

capabilities.name: browser.automation
capabilities.description: Drive a Chromium/Firefox/WebKit browser via a 127.0.0.1 HTTP API (navigate, click, type, screenshot, evaluate JS, scroll, tabs) with URL/selector input validation

storage.description: Persisted browser storage-state.json and screenshots under _runtime/browser/
